name: INFACT
description: Despite rapid progress, Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) remain unreliable due to hallucinations, which are outputs that contradict either video evidence (faithfulness) or verifiable world knowledge (factuality). Existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of factuality hallucinations and predominantly evaluate models only in clean settings. We introduce \textsc{INFACT}, a diagnostic benchmark comprising 9{,}800 QA instances with fine-grained taxonomies for faithfulness and factuality, spanning real and synthetic videos.
